vo.text: Wireless charging needs no metal plug between the pad and your phone.
vo.speak: Wireless charging needs no metal plug between the pad and your phone.

vo.text: It passes energy through a magnetic field.
vo.speak: It passes energy through a magnetic field.

vo.text: Inside the pad, alternating current flows through a coil.
vo.speak: Inside the pad, alternating current flows through a coil.

vo.text: That current makes the magnetic field rise and fall.
vo.speak: That current makes the magnetic field rise and fall.

vo.text: A second coil inside your phone sits within that field.
vo.speak: A second coil inside your phone sits within that field.

vo.text: The changing magnetism induces a voltage in this coil.
vo.speak: The changing magnetism induces a voltage in this coil.

vo.text: The phone turns that induced power into a form its battery can use.
vo.speak: The phone turns that induced power into a form its battery can use.

vo.text: The coils work best when they are close and aligned.
vo.speak: The coils work best when they are close and aligned.

vo.text: Distance and misalignment weaken the link and waste energy.
vo.speak: Distance and misalignment weaken the link and waste energy.

vo.text: So the cable disappears, but a pair of coils still makes the connection.
vo.speak: So the cable disappears, but a pair of coils still makes the connection.
